title: Cancer associated fibroblast-T cell crosstalk promotes purinergic synthesis in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
snippet: The most abundant stromal cells of the tumor microenvironment (TME), cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs), inhibit the cytotoxic T cell response in solid tumors. CD39 and CD73 together deplete extracellular ATP in the TME to produce adenosine, which can promote tumor immune evasion.
